assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Open /get-started with an isolated authenticated browser session and load the pre-created project/build.
steps.expected: Deployment form can select the isolated project and built artifact.
steps.observed: Signed-in dashboard loaded for e2e-pipeline-ut+browser-r3-20260315t125913@example.com; deployment form selected project proj_7990 and build bld_ed2fde36b9ace15b14216c33.

steps.action: Submit a preview deployment with target ref browser-deploy-r3-1773579553424.
steps.expected: Deployment Created result card shows deployment ID, status, domain, reachable endpoint link, and resource profile.

steps.action: Wait for automatic post-submit updates without clicking Refresh Deployments or Refresh Domains, then open View Logs from the deployment card.
steps.expected: Result card gains an endpoint link; deployment and domain cards refresh to running with endpoint; View Logs opens the modal.
